notes.title: True Virus is about to land!
notes.content:
Knock knock!

We are very pleased to announce that True Virus is spreading around Steam starting March 22!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090607/6aa0951a228c80958d9d09fd322fab4c4509993d.png

At 6 PM CET (10 AM PDT), you will wake up in a mental hospital and have a mystery to unravel as to why you are surrounded by a post-apocalyptic world. 
Ahead of you is an adventure full of puzzles, where step by step you will discover a dark secret.
Sound interesting?
That's not all, because we have a 30% discount for you to get started, which you can use for up to 14 days after the release!
